title: Container Bookings: roll compensation credit before the per-booking ceiling
content:
## Rule
For a compensated carrier roll on a Container Bookings booking, the credit before the per-booking ceiling is the tier's per-container roll compensation rate multiplied by the chargeable containers. A tier whose per-container roll compensation rate is 0.00 earns no credit, and no entry is written.

## Worked example (hypothetical)
*Hypothetical rate of 120.00 per container and 9 chargeable containers, for illustration only:* 120.00 multiplied by 9 gives a credit before the per-booking ceiling of 1080.00.

*Hypothetical tier with a rate of 0.00:* the credit before the per-booking ceiling is nothing, and no compensation entry is written for the roll.

## Points of judgement
**Is the rate applied to the booking's full container count?** It is applied to the chargeable containers.
